title: VDBE record serial-type lengths and scalar value decode

scope.rationale: These helpers are the source record-format boundary that maps serial types to payload lengths and decodes NULL, signed integers, IEEE-754 values, zero/one constants, and ephemeral text/blob views into exact Mem state.

external_source_responsibilities: Exact Mem/MemValue flags and scalar union layout
dependencies.caller_closure: The active size table, integer extraction macros, both local 8-byte decoders, public serial decoder, and both length APIs are assigned. Record unpack/compare callers remain follow-on units.

inputs: serial type and at least its encoded payload bytes; destination Mem
outputs: payload length and source-shaped Mem flags/scalar/view fields
contracts.ownership: Scalar/NULL values own no payload. Text/blob outputs are MEM_Ephem views into caller-owned input bytes. No prior Mem owner is released because source requires fresh destination state.
contracts.state_and_results: Types 0/11 are NULL; 10 is NULL|Zero no-change; 1..6 are signed big-endian integers; 7 is big-endian f64 with NaN mapped to NULL; 8/9 are integer 0/1; >=12 alternates blob/text and length floor((N-12)/2).
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: No connection, lock, callback, allocation, or I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: No failure path. serialGet7 returns one for NaN and zero for real while the public decoder communicates through Mem flags.

representation_differences: C sign-extension arithmetic is expressed with fixed-width bitcasts/subtraction in Zig; every resulting i64 bit pattern is identical.
Mixed-endian float support is absent from the pinned ABI/profile; big-endian record bits are bitcast to the host IEEE-754 f64 exactly as the active C branch.
The constant 128-byte size table is compile-time generated from the same fixed exceptional entries and alternating payload formula.

oracle.protocol: The shared worker decodes serial types 0 through 15 plus 127, 128, 129, 255, and 256 from sign-sensitive bytes, compares both length APIs, flags, n, union bits, and ephemeral pointer identity, then directly exercises serialGet7 with finite 1.0 and a NaN payload. C and Zig compare 366 observations.
internal_observations: blob/text ephemeral flags, lengths, and pointer identity
oracle.normalization: All flags, lengths, integer/floating union bits, and return values are exact; ephemeral addresses normalize to input-pointer identity.

assurance.io_crash_concurrency: Pure byte decoding; no I/O, callback, or shared state.
assurance.malformed_input: Source requires sufficient payload bytes; worker provides eight bytes and representative zero/positive payload lengths.
assurance.continuation: Decoded ephemeral values remain valid while fixture bytes live; scalar values are immediately reusable by record consumers.
assurance.performance: Constant-time table lookup/bit assembly and direct switch preserve source hot-path shape without allocation.

integration.native_call_path: Symbolic worker reaches exact Mem and record bytes. Record unpack/comparison/opcode call paths remain partially handwritten.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: No. Port record unpack, comparison, and MakeRecord callers.

independent_review.notes: Requires record subsystem integration, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Connect record opcodes to exact helpers.

No allocation, callback, lock, or I/O occurs
assertions_branches_cleanup: All 38 behavior IDs cover length threshold/assertions, float shape/NaN, and every serial-type switch family
Types 0/11 are NULL; 10 is NULL|Zero with n/nZero zero; 1..6 sign-extend exact widths; 7 finite is Real and NaN is Null; 8/9 are integer constants
Types >=12 borrow the input as MEM_Ephem and alternate blob/text by low bit with floor payload length; destination is required fresh and prior ownership is not released
Mixed-endian float and HP compiler workaround branches are inactive in the pinned profile
